note: `vp_token` must be a keyed object or a string, not a bare array.
A bare Data Integrity presentation object is not a keyed vp_token: its members are not arrays of presentations.
Each keyed value is an array of presentations, not a single presentation.
Each keyed value carries at least one presentation.
A keyed vp_token answers at least one credential query.
A credential query id uses only alphanumerics, underscore and hyphen.
A presentation is a string or an object, not a number.
The bare compatibility string is not empty.
Unknown top-level member is rejected (additionalProperties: false).
